derivation: middle voice from G2596 (κατά) and G4679 (σοφίζω);
def: to be crafty against, i.e. circumvent

occurrences.text: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.
